page.lead: User reports and automated rule flags pooled into a single queue with deadlines. Claim an item, review the context, and make a decision; the decision is executed immediately and the author is notified.
page.help: Use views and filters to narrow down the queue and sort by the nearest deadline. "Claim" assigns the report to you so two moderators don't work on the same item simultaneously. Decisions on reports you submitted or content you authored must be handled by another moderator.

queue.contentGone: This content is no longer visible in the community.
queue.emptyOpen: The queue is empty; no open reports to review.

page.lead: The same moderation queue, limited to community discussions and replies. Review each item and close it with a quick action — hide, remove, warn, or dismiss.
page.help: This queue shows reports and flags related to the community. You can also view reported messages and profiles using the content type filter. Hiding and removing actually removes the content from the community and can be restored from the action history.

decision.title: Report decision

ignore.label: Dismiss
ignore.hint: The report is closed; the content and author's account remain untouched.

hide.label: Hide
hide.hint: The content is hidden from the community and can be restored by any moderator. A notification is sent to the author.

remove.label: Remove
remove.hint: The content is removed from the community and can only be restored by an administrator. A notification is sent to the author.

warn.label: Warn author
warn.hint: An official warning is logged in the author's history and a notification is sent to them.

restrict.label: Temporary posting restriction
restrict.hint: The author cannot write discussions or replies in the community until the selected period ends.

escalate.label: Escalate to senior admin
escalate.hint: The report remains open and only an administrator can decide on it.

decision.noTarget: This report is not attached to a specific community content; hide and remove are unavailable.
decision.noAuthor: The author of this content is unknown; warnings and restrictions are not available.
decision.selfBlocked: You are the reporter or author of this content; the decision belongs to another moderator.
decision.escalatedBlocked: This report has been escalated; only an administrator can decide.
decision.alreadyClosed: This report has already been closed; no new decision can be recorded.

page.lead: Rules evaluate new community content and only flag it in the moderation queue for human decision-making upon violations.
page.help: Three types of rules are evaluated: keyword, posting velocity, and report threshold. The 'Suggested action' is only shown to the moderator in the queue and is never executed automatically. Use 'Test rule' before saving to check whether a rule flags sample text.

rules.flagOnlyNotice: Rules only flag items for the moderator. No content is hidden or removed automatically, and no users are restricted automatically.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? Existing flags will remain in the queue.
rules.emptyAll: No rules have been defined yet.
rules.emptyFilter: No rules found matching this filter.
rules.legacyHint: This rule was created before the evaluation engine and has no structured condition. Redefine the condition to enable it.

page.lead: Every moderation decision — hide, delete, warning, restriction, and restore — is recorded in this log with the actor, timestamp, and note. Reversible actions can be undone right here.
page.help: The "Actions" tab is the moderation engine's action log and includes a restore button; the "Report History" tab shows closed reports with search and filtering. Tap any row to view details.

log.legacyNote: Reports closed prior to the moderation engine are only visible in the "Report History" tab.
